game_title: Phone Book Rescue – Glacier Crossing Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Glacier Crossing, a cracking glacier: the sherpa guide must handle frost wyrms while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Phone Book Rescue: Add and update dictionary entries as contacts change.
theme: Frost Peaks – Glacier Crossing: a cracking glacier
core_gameplay_loop: In Glacier Crossing, repeat each round: Add and update dictionary entries as contacts change. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the contacts value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about contacts to power up the sherpa guide and open the summit beacon.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 7 (applied tier): Phone Book Rescue
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Phone Book Rescue' (Week 8 slot 8), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Glacier Crossing'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how contacts changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost wyrms in Glacier Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
